row: Doc Clemens FeLife® - Reduces FeLV Virus in Cats

FeLife® is proven to reduce the FeLV viral load in cats, helping support better health, stronger appetite, improved energy, and better days for FeLV+ cats.

On this channel, Dr. Paul Clemens, DVM, founder of Doc Clemens Remedies, shares compassionate, plain-English education about FeLV, FIV, FIP, feline immunity, testing, early support, and quality of life for cats facing serious viral illness.

FeLife is our natural, homeopathic feline immunity support remedy developed specifically for FeLV+ cats. In an independent 2024 rescue study using IDEXX ELISA + FeLV RealPCR testing, cats taking FeLife showed an average 61% FeLV viral load reduction within 30 days and an 87% average reduction within 60 days, with some cats testing negative or undetectable.

Dr. Clemens created FeLife to give caregivers a results-driven, gentle daily option for cats who deserve more hope, more comfort, and better days.
